population: All 30 June 2024 00 UTC GEFS control cycles and all three 24-hour leads; no cherry-picking by QC or outcome
source: Existing hash-verified Phase 4E/4F GEFS selected-message archive and frozen Track B model artifacts
reference: Existing hash-verified IMD 2024 0.25-degree daily rain, used only by the separate verification step
inference_rule: Reconstruct the experimental cell mask; put a zero placeholder into invalid rain rows only while constructing features; slice those rows out before any model call. Predict on valid rows with unchanged frozen M0/M2/M4 and forecast-only regime. Scatter NaN back to invalid cells; no imputation or retraining.
district_rule: Use pinned regional polygon weights. Include a candidate mean/probability only if at least 95% of that district's weighted grid area is valid; otherwise return null with explicit coverage and reason.
same_case_rule: On strict-pass cases, all candidate M0/M2/M4 valid-cell predictions must match the existing full-grid worker path to numerical tolerance 1e-6. On strict-withheld cases, compare M0/M2/M4 only over exactly the same jointly valid forecast/IMD cells; no fictional strict-model score.
no_promotion: Research candidate only. No live worker, bundle schema, API, dashboard or public-warning change; 2024 is a development validation year, not a new independent test.
